seo_title: B2B AI QA Agent: Automated Software Testing for SMEs
seo_desc: Are bugs ruining your software releases? We integrate an AI QA Agent to automate end-to-end testing, catching errors before they reach your B2B clients.
author_pitch: I have seen tech SMEs lose valuable corporate clients simply because a silly bug slipped into production. My mission is to deploy tireless AI agents that stress-test your code so you can release updates with absolute peace of mind.
title: AI QA Testing Agent: Eradicate Bugs from Your B2B Software
body:
Have your B2B clients become your free beta-testers because your team does not have time to check every update?

Releasing new features in a corporate SaaS or custom B2B software without exhaustive quality control is playing Russian roulette. Tech SMEs usually cannot afford a full-time QA (Quality Assurance) department, which causes bugs to reach production, break your clients' operations, and destroy your reputation in minutes.

The trap of manual testing by developers

Forcing the same programmers who wrote the code to find their own errors does not work; they are biased and their time is too expensive to be doing repetitive clicks. Paying Senior engineers to manually fill out test forms is like burning bills in a bonfire.

Our solution: Automated QA & Testing AI Agent

At LANZAESTUDIO we train and integrate an AI Agent that acts as a relentless 24/7 tester. This AI navigates your application just like a human user would, stress-testing the system and validating critical B2B flows before every deployment.

  1. Automated Test Writing: The AI analyzes your source code and automatically writes hundreds of test scripts (E2E, integration, and unit) without human intervention.
  2. Visual Cognitive Navigation: The agent simulates clicks, fills out forms, and evaluates the interface (UI) using computer vision to ensure no button is left inaccessible.
  3. Real-Time Regression Detection: It integrates into your CI/CD pipeline to block any push to production if the AI detects that older logic has broken.
  4. Forensic Error Reporting: Instead of a simple warning, the AI records the error on video, captures the logs, and proposes the exact code snippet to fix it.

The Real Impact on Your B2B Software Company

  • Enterprise-Grade Quality: You deliver flawless updates that strengthen the retention of your corporate clients, eliminating bug-related support tickets.
  • Deployment Acceleration: You reduce the testing cycle from days to just a few minutes, allowing your SME to launch innovations to the market much faster.
  • Talent Profitability: Your developers stop doing tedious manual tests and dedicate 100% of their time to creating profitable new features.
